info.title: CobaltumORM tool
info.description: Command-line migration management and explicit C# code generation for CobaltumORM.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output directory for migrations init
Output directory for directory and library modes

options.name: --project
options.description: Migration .csproj file or its directory

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework for init or dotnet run

options.name: --provider
options.description:
Database provider for init (default: PostgreSql)
PostgreSql, MySql, Sqlite, SqlServer, or Oracle
Database provider when it is not set in the project

options.name: --environment
options.description: Environment name (default: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT or Production)

options.name: --settings
options.description: JSON settings file used instead of appsettings files

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Do not build the migration project

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show migration files, SQL, and final schema without changes

options.name: --version
options.description: Version for a new migration

options.name: --output-mode
options.description:
intermediate (default), directory, or library
intermediate writes under the project obj directory
directory writes a durable directory you can check in
library writes a directory that compiles as its own project

options.name: --library-name
options.description: Name of the library project the tool writes

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Do not restore before evaluating the project

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the MSBuild command and its output
